the highest antioxidants were extracted from sapodilla peel extract, followed by sapodilla pulp, and then sapodilla seed.

ethanol extraction of sapodilla peel and pulp at 40% and 80% ethanol, respectively, for 2 h and 4 h, respectively, at 60 and 40°C, respectively, is the optimal extraction condition that would extract maximum antioxidants from the sapodilla peel or pulp.

sapodilla peel extract is more potent than its pulp extract in terms of TPC and AA.

ethanol extraction of sapodilla peel and pulp can be an efficient method for extracting high amounts of antioxidant compounds.

the optimal conditions for extracting antioxidants from sapodilla fruit pulp and peel are different.
